requirements.text: The Framework must be capable of capturing information from the software tools specified in Table 3.9.3-A.
The user must be able to view the information in the central store in a hierarchical manner that makes sense to him.
The Framework must guard against malicious scripts on remote websites from accessing its information.
The Framework must guard against unintended corruption of information by the user himself.
The mean time between failures (MTBF) shall exceed 3 months.
Any coding conventions to be used during implementation must be documented before the beginning of the phase, and strictly adhered to during the phase.
The website for distributing the project shall include provisions for the users to make comments on the product as well as to compile a wish-list of features.
The system shall conform to ISO 10646 (Unicode UTF-8) and optionally ISO 10646-1 (Unicode UTF-16) standards for character set encoding.

The Framework shall implement a sandboxing mechanism to isolate third-party application data access and enforce strict input validation on all captured information to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) and code injection attacks.
The Framework shall implement role-based access control (RBAC) and a transaction-based commit system to prevent unauthorized or accidental modification of information entities.
The Framework shall implement an independent security layer that validates the integrity of data received from third-party applications, regardless of the source application's security posture.
The system shall maintain an MTBF of 2,160 operational hours, where a failure is defined as any system crash or data corruption event requiring manual intervention to restore service.
The Framework shall implement a sandboxing mechanism to isolate external content and enforce a strict policy preventing unauthorized execution of scripts within the data store context.
The system shall implement atomic write operations and a transaction log to ensure data integrity and provide a rollback mechanism for user-initiated modifications.
The Framework shall maintain a resident memory footprint of no more than 40MB while managing a dataset of up to 10,000 entities.
The Framework shall capture and index information with a latency of no more than 500ms for email dispatch and 1s for web document archival.
The hierarchical browser shall render the view of the information store within 200ms for up to 10,000 entities.
The system shall support a minimum of 100,000 Entities and a total data store size of 50GB without performance degradation.
